title: Adjusted remittance on a line with a copay
assertion: `approved` for the payment increase, the allowed increase when the copay is unchanged; beside a coinsurance line of the same claim, interest split and a provider-level withholding taken in order by what the payer pays

files.description: The original payment: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00 against an expected 100.00 (a case line), CO-45 80.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 50.00.
The adjusted remittance: the original reversed (PR-3 -20.00, paid -50.00) and the correction allowed 100.00, CO-45 50.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 80.00: BPR02 30.00.
A posting export with one check-level row posting the adjusted check, 30.00.
The bank export: one deposit of 30.00 matched by trace number and amount.

Another patient's original payment of two case lines on one day: 97110 x 2 allowed 70.00, CO-45 80.00, PR-2 coinsurance 14.00, paid 56.00, and 97110-59 x 2 allowed 70.00, CO-45 80.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 50.00: BPR02 106.00.

Its adjusted remittance: the original reversed (paid -106.00) and the correction, 97110 allowed 100.00, PR-2 coinsurance 20.00, paid 80.00, and 97110-59 allowed 100.00, PR-3 copay 20.00, paid 80.00, with claim interest AMT I 5.40: BPR02 54.00.
A later remittance whose PLB WO takes back 30.00 against the corrected claim (SYNCCNLED160004), beside another patient's claim paying 150.00: BPR02 120.00.

scenario.packet: submitted for the 97110 line before the adjusted remittance arrives

twoLines.note: interest split and the withholding taken in line order by what the payer pays on each line; by allowed they would be 2.70 and 2.70, and 30.00 and 0
